title: Adorable cat surprisingly holds her own in impromptu boxing showdown with man
description:
Canelo Álvarez, Devin Haney, and Tyson Fury have nothing on the paw-some boxer featured in this clip.

"This video shows my boyfriend boxing our friend’s cat, Eileen!" the filmer, Faith, told WooGlobe. "Eileen is a boxing cat!"

The way the kitty balances on her hind paws with a face of unwavering concentration is both adorable and impressive.

Additionally, Eileen’s precision in dodging the man’s punches should make viewers wonder why big promoters aren’t flocking to feature her in the main event of a blockbuster stadium show.
Location: Oswego, New York, USA
